panels.description: Cluster-wide totals after applying deleted_at filters where relevant.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  regexp_replace(version(), 'PostgreSQL ([^ ]+) .*', '\1') AS pg_version,
  pg_database_size(current_database())                  AS db_size,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM pois        WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS active_pois,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM reservables WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS active_reservables,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM availability_snapshot)               AS availability_snapshots,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM availability_watch WHERE status = 'active') AS active_watches;

panels.title: Cluster summary

panels.description: User tables only. data + indexes + toast. bloat_pct = dead tuples / live tuples.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  c.relname                            AS table_name,
  pg_relation_size(c.oid)              AS data_bytes,
  pg_indexes_size(c.oid)               AS index_bytes,
  pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)        AS total_bytes,
  s.n_live_tup                         AS live_rows,
  s.n_dead_tup                         AS dead_rows,
  CASE WHEN s.n_live_tup > 0
       THEN round(100.0 * s.n_dead_tup / s.n_live_tup, 1)
       ELSE 0
  END                                  AS bloat_pct
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid = c.oid
WHERE c.relkind = 'r'
  AND n.nspname = 'public'
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) DESC;

panels.title: Table storage

panels.description: Tables where seq scans dominate index scans (potential missing index). Filters to tables > 1k live rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  relname                              AS table_name,
  n_live_tup                           AS live_rows,
  seq_scan,
  idx_scan,
  round(seq_scan::numeric / NULLIF(idx_scan + seq_scan, 0), 3) AS seq_scan_share,
  seq_tup_read                         AS seq_tuples_read
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE n_live_tup > 1000
  AND seq_scan > 10 * idx_scan
ORDER BY seq_scan DESC;

panels.title: Missing-index suspects (seq scans dominate)

panels.description: Indexes that have never been scanned and waste > 1MB. Candidates for removal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.relname                            AS table_name,
  s.indexrelname                       AS index_name,
  pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid)       AS index_bytes,
  i.indisunique                        AS is_unique,
  i.indisprimary                       AS is_primary
FROM pg_stat_user_indexes s
JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = s.indexrelid
WHERE s.idx_scan = 0
  AND pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid) > 1024 * 1024
  AND NOT i.indisunique
  AND NOT i.indisprimary
ORDER BY pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid) DESC;

panels.title: Unused indexes (idx_scan = 0, > 1MB)

panels.description: Age since last vacuum or autovacuum. Red > 7 days, yellow > 1 day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  relname                                    AS table_name,
  n_live_tup                                 AS live_rows,
  n_dead_tup                                 AS dead_rows,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - GREATEST(last_vacuum, last_autovacuum))   AS vacuum_age_sec,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - GREATEST(last_analyze, last_autoanalyze)) AS analyze_age_sec,
  GREATEST(last_vacuum, last_autovacuum)     AS last_vacuum,
  GREATEST(last_analyze, last_autoanalyze)   AS last_analyze
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE n_live_tup > 0
ORDER BY GREATEST(last_vacuum, last_autovacuum) ASC NULLS FIRST;

panels.title: Vacuum / analyze freshness

panels.description: Hardcoded list — keep in sync with new core tables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT *
FROM (
  VALUES
    ('pois',                  (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM pois)),
    ('active_pois',           (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM pois WHERE deleted_at IS NULL)),
    ('reservables',           (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM reservables)),
    ('active_reservables',    (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM reservables WHERE deleted_at IS NULL)),
    ('reservable_pois',       (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM reservable_pois)),
    ('availability_snapshot', (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM availability_snapshot)),
    ('availability_watch',    (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM availability_watch)),
    ('availability_job',      (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM availability_job)),
    ('availability_job_run',  (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM availability_job_run)),
    ('ingest_runs',           (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM ingest_runs)),
    ('import_runs',           (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM import_runs)),
    ('api_cache_metadata',    (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM grafana_api_cache_metadata))
) AS counts(table_name, exact_rows)
ORDER BY exact_rows DESC;

panels.title: Exact core row counts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'pois'                  AS table_name, max(updated_at)::timestamptz   AS latest_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(updated_at))   AS latest_update_age FROM pois
UNION ALL
SELECT 'reservables',                       max(updated_at),                              EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(updated_at))   FROM reservables
UNION ALL
SELECT 'availability_snapshot',             max(observed_at),                             EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(observed_at))  FROM availability_snapshot
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ingest_runs',                       max(completed_at),                            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(completed_at)) FROM ingest_runs
UNION ALL
SELECT 'import_runs',                       max(completed_at),                            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(completed_at)) FROM import_runs
ORDER BY latest_update_age DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT
  namespace,
  count(*)                                        AS rows,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE expires_at <= now())     AS expired_rows,
  sum(payload_bytes)::bigint                      AS payload_bytes,
  min(created_at)                                 AS oldest_created_at,
  max(created_at)                                 AS newest_created_at
FROM grafana_api_cache_metadata
GROUP BY namespace
ORDER BY rows DESC;
SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension ORDER BY extname ASC;

panels.description: All public tables: row estimate + total size. Click a row to focus the schema panel on the right.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  c.relname                            AS table_name,
  obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class')   AS comment,
  coalesce(s.n_live_tup, 0)            AS live_rows,
  pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)        AS total_bytes
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid = c.oid
WHERE c.relkind = 'r'
  AND n.nspname = 'public'
ORDER BY c.relname ASC;

panels.title: Public tables

panels.description: Columns for the selected table. PK / FK / not-null / default surfaced inline.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.oid, c.relname
  FROM pg_class c
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
    AND c.relkind = 'r'
    AND c.relname = ${table_name:sqlstring}
),
pk_cols AS (
  SELECT a.attname
  FROM t
  JOIN pg_index i ON i.indrelid = t.oid AND i.indisprimary
  JOIN unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) ON true
  JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum
),
fk_cols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.attname,
    cf.relname || '(' || af.attname || ')' AS references_table
  FROM t
  JOIN pg_constraint con ON con.conrelid = t.oid AND con.contype = 'f'
  JOIN unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) ON true
  JOIN unnest(con.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS kf(attnum, ord) ON kf.ord = k.ord
  JOIN pg_attribute a  ON a.attrelid  = t.oid          AND a.attnum  = k.attnum
  JOIN pg_class     cf ON cf.oid       = con.confrelid
  JOIN pg_attribute af ON af.attrelid = con.confrelid AND af.attnum = kf.attnum
)
SELECT
  a.attnum                                    AS ordinal,
  a.attname                                   AS column_name,
  format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)        AS data_type,
  a.attnotnull                                AS not_null,
  pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid)             AS default_expr,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pk_cols WHERE attname = a.attname) AS is_pk,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fk_cols WHERE attname = a.attname) AS is_fk,
  (SELECT references_table FROM fk_cols WHERE attname = a.attname LIMIT 1) AS references_table,
  col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum)       AS comment
FROM t
JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid
LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = t.oid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
WHERE a.attnum > 0
  AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum;
